description: Ground-truth manifest for the reference sample app. Each entry records, per route/behavior, the verdict a correct live run must produce and which template should fire. The confusion matrix and per-template corroboration metrics are computed against this file — grow it whenever a milestone adds a capability.

expectations.behavior: public health check with full security headers (control)
requires auth; anonymous gets 401, authenticated gets 200
data-shaped 200 with no auth and no public marker (exposure)
expectations.note: unknown-expectation exposure produces a capped-severity candidate, never an auto-confirmed finding

expectations.behavior: any authenticated user can read any other user (IDOR / tenant isolation)
requires auth and sets full security headers (hardened control); the 401 challenge carries the same headers, so the anonymous security-header probe observes the hardened posture
public route served with no security headers
